text:
Picture a tiler in Melbourne. Five times a week a customer asks him: "How long before I can use the shower again?"

He answers it on the phone every time.

Write that answer once as a blog post on your website. Now the people asking Google the same question find you.

Run Google Ads? Check which offers Google is showing in your ads.

Go to Campaigns, then Assets. Filter by Promotion.

Anything with "Google AI" in the Added by column, Google wrote for you from deals it found on your website.

Not your offer? Switch off automated promotions in Advanced settings.

Facebook ads are a megaphone. They make what you already sell louder.

Regulars who rebook every year? The ads find more people like them.

No regulars yet? You pay to tell strangers about something they won't buy.

Read this first:
https://gimsresults.com.au/post/are-facebook-ads-worth-it
